'''General Marshoo's Eatery''' was a restaurant located in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was owned and operated by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Brass Marshoo]].
